article.title: The Slum Reproduction Machine
article.author: Hussain Indorewala
article.content: The supposed “slum free Mumbai” policy is premised on tearing down the actually existing affordable housing in the city to create land for building unaffordable housing. The post The Slum Reproduction Machine appeared first on MR Online .
